title: NBA: Tony Parker sees bright future for Spurs with Wembanyama, young core
summary: After reaching the NBA finals last season, Tony Parker believes it's only a matter of time before the San Antonio Spurs win it all with the new generation of talent led by Victor Wembanyama.
